from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,tarfile,shutil
base=Path('.dip-local/rollback-20261029');base.mkdir(mode=0o700)
root=Path.home(); installed=Path('/opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@vxu-labs/dip')
archive=base/'dip-0.3.12-installed.tar.gz'
with tarfile.open(archive,'w:gz') as t:t.add(installed,arcname='dip')
files=[root/p for p in ['.codex/config.toml','.codex/hooks.json','.claude/settings.json','.claude.json','.dip/install.json','.gitconfig','.config/git/config','.zshrc','.bashrc','Library/LaunchAgents/dev.dip.plist']]
files += list((root/'.dip/git-hooks').glob('*'))
for r in json.loads(Path('/tmp/dip-upgrade-roots.json').read_text()):
 files += [Path(r)/p for p in ['AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','.dip/config.json','.dip/integration.json','.dip/intent-guide.md','.dip/tools/portable.mjs','.agents/skills/dip/SKILL.md','.claude/skills/dip/SKILL.md']]
manifest={'package':archive.name,'packageSha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'settings':[]}
for i,f in enumerate(dict.fromkeys(files)):
 entry={'source':str(f),'exists':f.exists()}
 if f.is_file():
  dst=base/f'settings-{i}{f.suffix}';shutil.copy2(f,dst);os.chmod(dst,0o600)
  entry.update(backup=dst.name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),mode=oct(f.stat().st_mode & 0o777))
 manifest['settings'].append(entry)
(base/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n');os.chmod(base/'manifest.json',0o600)
print(json.dumps({'backup':str(base.resolve()),'settings':len(manifest['settings']),'packageBytes':archive.stat().st_size}))
